user_query.title: Fit graphene Raman G and 2D peaks
user_query.text: Fit the G and 2D peaks of the provided Raman Setup output spectrum measured on a graphene sample. Determine the x0, gamma, amplitude, and offset for each peak and write the results to "/app/results.json" in the specified format, with top-level "G" and "2D" objects each containing "x0", "gamma", "amplitude", and "offset".

Analysis: Data loaded fine: 3565 lines, two columns with comma decimal separators, tab-separated. X descends from 47183 to 1648.7 with nonlinear spacing, suggesting x is not directly Raman shift (G peak at ~1580 cm-1 would be out of range). It could be absolute wavenumber or wavelength in Angstrom. Numpy/scipy installed. I need to inspect the data to find peaks and determine the x-axis units.
Plan: Write a quick python script to load the data and locate the prominent peaks, then determine the unit conversion (likely Raman shift = laser wavenumber - x, or conversion from wavelength).
